chunks.content: 96 Thinking about moving? Don’t wait for the perfect job. Hi Sara, Not everyone relocates for a job. Some people buy the job so they can relocate. I work with a lot of accountants who’ve built solid careers, but want a change. Smaller town. Closer to family. Slower pace. The challenge? Those dream locations don’t usually come with dream job offers. So they buy the firm. A small accounting practice With an existing team An office chair that’s already worn in! And enough margin to support their lifestyle from day one No five-year ramp-up. No late-night scrambling for clients living in your parents’ basement. Just a business that pays, in a place they actually want to be. It’s not about skipping hard work. It’s about not having to start from scratch when you don’t have time (or patience) for that anymore. If you could move anywhere and be your own boss, where would it be? Hit reply - I’d love to hear where your head goes.
